title: Ravana instructs Prahasta to defend Lanka
introduction: Ravana instructs Prahasta, chief of his army to defend the city of Lanka carefully. Prahasta positioned the army for defense accordingly at suitable places both inside and outside the city. Ravana then narrates how he brought beautiful Seetha to Lanka from Dandaka forest, because of his growing infatuation for her. Ravana asks his companions and relatives gathered there, to suggest ways and means to kill Rama and Lakshmana. Then, Kumbhakarna, Ravana's brother first accuses Ravana of his unworthy act but assures him that he would neutralize that dishonour by killing the enemies.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्वादशः सर्गः
Thus completes 12th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
स ताम् परिषदम् कृत्स्नाम् समीक्ष्य समितिम्जयः |
प्रबोधयामास तदा प्रहस्तम् वाहिनीपतिम्
verses.iast:
sa tām pariṣadam kṛtsnām samīkśya samitimjayaḥ |
prabodhayāmāsa tadā prahastam vāhinīpatim
verses.translation: Then, Ravana an eminent person in the assembly, having seen all that gathering, instructed Prahasta the chief of his army (as follows):

glosses.meaning: the commander of the army (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
सेनापते यथा ते स्युः कृतविद्याश्चतुर्विधाः |
योधा नगररक्षायाम् तथा व्यादेष्टुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
senāpate yathā te syuḥ kṛtavidyāścaturvidhāḥ |
yodhā nagararakśāyām tathā vyādeṣṭumarhasi
verses.translation: "O, commander! You are allowed to issue an order to see that well-trained warriors belonging to the four divisions of the army (viz.cavalry, infantry, chariots and elephants) are entrusted with the defense of the city."

glosses.meaning: in that way' arhasi = you are allowed

verses.devanagari:
स प्रहस्तः प्रतीतात्मा चिकीर्षन् राजशासनम् |
विनिक्षिपद् बलम् सर्वम् बहिरन्तश्च मन्दिरे
verses.iast:
sa prahastaḥ pratītātmā cikīrṣan rājaśāsanam |
vinikśipad balam sarvam bahirantaśca mandire
verses.translation: Prahasta, resolute in his mind to follow the king's orders stationed the whole army both outside as well as inside the city.

verses.devanagari:
ततो विनिक्षिप्य बलम् सर्वम् नगरगुप्तये |
प्रहस्तः प्रमुखे राज्ञो निषसाद जगाद च
verses.iast:
tato vinikśipya balam sarvam nagaraguptaye |
prahastaḥ pramukhe rājJṇo niṣasāda jagāda ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, Prahasta after keeping the whole army in defence of the city, sat in front of the king and spoke (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
विहितम् बहिरन्तश्च बलम् बलवतस्तव |
कुरुष्वाविमनाः क्षिप्रम् यदभिप्रेतमस्ति ते
verses.iast:
vihitam bahirantaśca balam balavatastava |
kuruṣvāvimanāḥ kśipram yadabhipretamasti te
verses.translation: Your army, as strong as you are, has been positioned both outside and inside the city. Pray do quickly, with an undistracted mind, whatever is preferable to you."

verses.devanagari:
प्रहस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राजा राज्यहितैषिणः |
सुखेप्सुः सुहृदाम् मध्ये व्याजहार स रावणः
verses.iast:
prahastasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā rājyahitaiṣiṇaḥ |
sukhepsuḥ suhṛdām madhye vyājahāra sa rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Prahasta, who wished the welfare of the kingdom, king Ravana, with a desire to obtain happiness, spoke in the desire midst of his friends as follows:

glosses.meaning: who wished the welfare of the kingdom

verses.devanagari:
प्रियाप्रिये सुख दुःखम् लाभालाभे सिताहिते |
धर्मकामार्थकृच्च्रेषु यूयमार्हथ वेदितुम्
verses.iast:
priyāpriye sukha duḥkham lābhālābhe sitāhite |
dharmakāmārthakṛccreṣu yūyamārhatha veditum
verses.translation: When you are in difficult situations regarding virtue pleasure and wealth, you are able to have a correct notion of pleasant and unpleasant things, happiness and sorrow, gain and detriment as well as advantages and disadvantages."

glosses.meaning: are in difficult situations regarding virtue pleasure and wealth
and of advantages and disadvantages of things.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वकृत्यानि युष्माभिः समारब्धनि सर्वदा |
मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानि न जातु विफलानि मे
verses.iast:
sarvakṛtyāni yuṣmābhiḥ samārabdhani sarvadā |
mantrakarmaniyuktāni na jātu viphalāni me
verses.translation: "All of my works undertaken by you with an act of attention, were never in vain."

verses.devanagari:
ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैर्मरुद्भिरिव वासवः |
भवद्भिरहमत्यर्थम् वृतः श्रियमवाप्नुयाम्
verses.iast:
sasomagrahanakśatrairmarudbhiriva vāsavaḥ |
bhavadbhirahamatyartham vṛtaḥ śriyamavāpnuyām
verses.translation: "I will obtain maximum prosperity, while abiding with you, as Indra obtains properity while abiding with moon, planets, stars and celestials."

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तु खलु सर्वन्वः समर्थयुतुमुद्यतः |
कुमभकर्णस्य तु स्वप्नान्नेममर्थमचोदयम्
verses.iast:
aham tu khalu sarvanvaḥ samarthayutumudyataḥ |
kumabhakarṇasya tu svapnānnemamarthamacodayam
verses.translation: "I am intent on reminding all of you again. But I could not inform this matter earlier to Kumbhakarna because of his sleep."

verses.devanagari:
अयम् हि सुप्तः ष्ण्मासान् कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः |
सर्वशस्त्रभृतम् मुख्यः स इदानीम् समुत्थितः
verses.iast:
ayam hi suptaḥ ṣṇmāsān kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ |
sarvaśastrabhṛtam mukhyaḥ sa idānīm samutthitaḥ
verses.translation: "This most powerful Kumbhakarna, the chief among all the wielders of weapons, was indeed sleeping for the last six months and now, he woke up."

glosses.meaning: among the entire wielders of weapons

verses.devanagari:
इयम् च दण्डकारण्य़ाद्रामस्य महिषी प्रिया |
रक्षोभिश्चरितोद्देशादानीता जनकात्मजा
verses.iast:
iyam ca daṇḍakāraṇYādrāmasya mahiṣī priyā |
rakśobhiścaritoddeśādānītā janakātmajā
verses.translation: "Seetha the beloved wife of Rama was brought from the forest of Dandaka, the place frequented by demons."

verses.devanagari:
सा मे न शय्यामारोढुमिच्चत्यलसगामिनी |
त्रिषुलोकेषु चान्या मे न सीतासदृशी मता
verses.iast:
sā me na śayyāmāroḍhumiccatyalasagāminī |
triṣulokeṣu cānyā me na sītāsadṛśī matā
verses.translation: Seetha of languid pace, does not like to reach my bed. I do not imagine any other woman similar to Seetha existing in the three worlds."

verses.devanagari:
तनुमध्या पृथुश्रोणी शरदिन्दुनिभानना |
हेमबिम्बनिभा सौम्यामायेव मयनिर्मिता
verses.iast:
tanumadhyā pṛthuśroṇī śaradindunibhānanā |
hemabimbanibhā saumyāmāyeva mayanirmitā
verses.translation: "She has a slim waist, well-developed hips, and a face similar to an autumnal moon. Looking like an idol of gold and being placid She appears like an illusory image created by Maya.
notes: Maya: Architect of demons, also versed in magic, astronomy and military science.

glosses.meaning: her face similar to antumnal moon
looking like an image of gold

verses.devanagari:
सुलोहिततलौ श्लक्क्षणौ चरणौ सुप्रतिष्ठतौ |
दृष्ट्वा ताम्रनखौ तस्या दीप्यते मे शरीरजः
verses.iast:
sulohitatalau ślakkśaṇau caraṇau supratiṣṭhatau |
dṛṣṭvā tāmranakhau tasyā dīpyate me śarīrajaḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing Her feet with rose-coloured soles, smooth and evenly resting on ground with the rosy soles, my lust is kindled."

verses.devanagari:
हुताग्निरर्चिःसम्काशामेनाम् सौरीमिव प्रभाम् |
उन्नसम् विमलम् वल्गु वदनम् चारुलोचनम्
पश्यंस्तदवशस्तस्याः कामस्य वशमेयिवान् |
verses.iast:
hutāgnirarciḥsamkāśāmenām saurīmiva prabhām |
unnasam vimalam valgu vadanam cārulocanam
paśyaṃstadavaśastasyāḥ kāmasya vaśameyivān |
verses.translation: "Seeing her countenance similar to the flame of a sacrificial fire and looking like the radiance of the sun, with her prominent nose and the pretty clear and handsome eyes, I became unrestrained, having submitted to the will of my passion."

glosses.meaning: similar to the flame of a sacrificial fire
not being in my fire will

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधहर्षसमानेन दुर्वर्णकरणेन च
शोकसम्तापनित्येन कामेन कलुषीकृतः |
verses.iast:
krodhaharṣasamānena durvarṇakaraṇena ca
śokasamtāpanityena kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: "I have been polluted by lust and equally by anger and pleasure thus making me pale and I have been ever since in grief and anguish."

glosses.meaning: and is ever present in grief and anguish."

verses.devanagari:
सा तु सम्वत्सरम् कालम् मामयाचत भामिनी
प्रतीक्षमाणा भर्तारम् राममायतलोचना |
तन्मया चारुनेत्रायाः प्रतिज्ञातम् वचः शुभम्
श्रान्तोऽहम् सततम् कामाद्यातो हय इवाध्वनि |
verses.iast:
sā tu samvatsaram kālam māmayācata bhāminī
pratīkśamāṇā bhartāram rāmamāyatalocanā |
tanmayā cārunetrāyāḥ pratijJṇātam vacaḥ śubham
śrānto'ham satatam kāmādyāto haya ivādhvani |
verses.translation: "Looking forward Rama, her husband, that longish large eyed Seetha, requested me to give time for one year. I accepted the auspicious words of the charmingly eyed Seetha. I am wearied of this lust, like a horse galloping along a path continuously."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् सागरमक्षोभ्यम् तरिष्यन्ति वनौकसः
बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णम् तौ वा दशरथात्मजौ |
verses.iast:
katham sāgaramakśobhyam tariṣyanti vanaukasaḥ
bahusattvasamākīrṇam tau vā daśarathātmajau |
verses.translation: How the monkeys or even Rama and Lakshmana can cross the unassailable ocean, completely infested as it was with sea-animals?"

verses.devanagari:
अथवा कपिनैकेन कृतम् नः कदनम् महत्
दुर्ज्ञेयाः कार्यगतयो ब्रूत यस्य यथामति |
verses.iast:
athavā kapinaikena kṛtam naḥ kadanam mahat
durjJṇeyāḥ kāryagatayo brūta yasya yathāmati |
verses.translation: "on the other hand, a huge destruction was done to us, by a single monkey. The consequences of their acts are unpredictable. Tell me what is there in your mind, according to your own understanding."

verses.devanagari:
मानुषान्नो भयम् नास्ति तथापि तु विमृश्यताम्
तदा देवासुरे युद्दे युष्माभिः सहितोऽजयम् |
ते मे भवन्तश्च तथा सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् हरीन्
परे पारे समुद्रस्य पुरस्कृत्य नृपात्मजौ |
सीतायाः पदवीम् प्राप्य सम्प्राप्तौ वरुणालयम्
verses.iast:
mānuṣānno bhayam nāsti tathāpi tu vimṛśyatām
tadā devāsure yudde yuṣmābhiḥ sahito'jayam |
te me bhavantaśca tathā sugrīvapramukhān harīn
pare pāre samudrasya puraskṛtya nṛpātmajau |
sītāyāḥ padavīm prāpya samprāptau varuṇālayam
verses.translation: "We have no fear with human beings. Even so, the matter can be discussed. Earlier, together with you, I conquered the celestials in a battle between the celestials and demons. You also conquered them. Knowing the whereabouts of Seetha, Rama and Lakshmana together with Sugreeva and other monkeys reached the other shore of the ocean."

glosses.meaning: in the battle between celestials and demons

verses.devanagari:
अदेया च यथा सीता वध्यौ दशरथात्मजौ |
भवद्भिर्मन्त्य्रताम् मन्त्रः सुनीतम् चाभिधीयताम्
verses.iast:
adeyā ca yathā sītā vadhyau daśarathātmajau |
bhavadbhirmantyratām mantraḥ sunītam cābhidhīyatām
verses.translation: "Let a consultation be held by you and a judicious line of course suggested, so that Seetha may not have to be handed -over to them back and Rama and Lakshmana may be killed."

verses.devanagari:
न हि शक्तिम् प्रपश्यामि जगत्यन्यस्य कस्यचित् |
सागरम् वानरैस्तीर्त्वा विश्चयेन जयो मम
verses.iast:
na hi śaktim prapaśyāmi jagatyanyasya kasyacit |
sāgaram vānaraistīrtvā viścayena jayo mama
verses.translation: "I do not see any other's capability to cross the ocean even so with the monkeys. Victory is surely mine."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य कामपरीतस्य निशम्य परिदेवितम् |
कुम्भकर्णः प्रचुक्रोध वचनम् चेदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tasya kāmaparītasya niśamya paridevitam |
kumbhakarṇaḥ pracukrodha vacanam cedamabravīt
verses.translation: Hearing the lamentation of Ravana who was captivated by lust, Kumbhakarana became angry and spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
यदा तु रामस्य सलक्ष्मणस्य |
प्रसह्य सीता खलु पा इहाऽहृता |
सकृत्समीक्षैव सुनिश्चितम् तदा |
भजेत चित्तम् यमुनेव यामुनम्
verses.iast:
yadā tu rāmasya salakśmaṇasya |
prasahya sītā khalu pā ihā'hṛtā |
sakṛtsamīkśaiva suniścitam tadā |
bhajeta cittam yamuneva yāmunam
verses.translation: "You should have contemplated thoroughly that very moment when Seetha was brought here forcibly only after a single impulsive thought from the hermitage of Rama, who was accompanied by Lakshmana, even like the river Yamuna fills the depression at its source the moment it descends on earth."

glosses.meaning: like filling the depression at its source

verses.devanagari:
सर्वमेतन्महाराज कृतमप्रतिमम् तव |
विधीयेत सहास्माभिरादावेवास्य कर्मणः
verses.iast:
sarvametanmahārāja kṛtamapratimam tava |
vidhīyeta sahāsmābhirādāvevāsya karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "O, emperor! If all this act of consultation with us was done at the beginning of this action itself (of bringing Seetha here), it would have been worthy of you."

glosses.meaning: act of consultation asmaabhiH saha = with us

verses.devanagari:
न्यायेन राजकार्याणि यः करोति दशानन |
न स सम्तप्यते पश्चान्निश्चतार्थमतिर्नृपः
verses.iast:
nyāyena rājakāryāṇi yaḥ karoti daśānana |
na sa samtapyate paścānniścatārthamatirnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: "O, Ravana! A king who performs king's functions with a mind duly ascertained by justice, will not repent thereafter."

verses.devanagari:
अनुपायेन कर्माणि विपरीतानि यानि च |
क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवीम्ष्यप्रयतेष्विन
verses.iast:
anupāyena karmāṇi viparītāni yāni ca |
kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīmṣyaprayateṣvina
verses.translation: "Actions done pervertedly without use of any stratagem get spoiled, even as oblations not intent on devotion got spoiled.

verses.devanagari:
यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति |
पूर्वम् चापरकर्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ
verses.iast:
yaḥ paścātpūrvakāryāṇi karmāṇyabhicikīrṣati |
pūrvam cāparakaryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau
verses.translation: "He who is not aware of prudence and imprudence, wants to do actions which are to be done before at a later stage and actions which are to be done later at a stage before."

glosses.meaning: which ought to be done before
and actions which ought to be done later

verses.devanagari:
चपलस्य तु कृत्येषु प्रसमीक्स्याधिकम् बलम् |
चिद्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य खमिव द्विजाः
verses.iast:
capalasya tu kṛtyeṣu prasamīksyādhikam balam |
cidramanye prapadyante krauJṇcasya khamiva dvijāḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing superior strength in a hasteful enemy, some look for his weak point, even as swans seek the cleavage in the Kraunca mountain."
notes: God Kartikeya (son of Lord Shiva) made a cleavage in Krauncha mountain with His javelin. (Mahabharata, Salya Parva 46-84).

verses.devanagari:
त्वयेदम् महादारभम् कार्य मप्रतिचिन्तितम् |
दिष्ट्या त्वाम् नावधीद्रामो विषमिश्रमिवामृतम्
verses.iast:
tvayedam mahādārabham kārya mapraticintitam |
diṣṭyā tvām nāvadhīdrāmo viṣamiśramivāmṛtam
verses.translation: "This great act was undertaken by you without proper thinking. By good fortune, Rama did not kill you even as the meat mixed with poison would kill the consumer."

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात्त्वया समारब्धम् कर्म ह्यप्रतिमम् परैः |
अहम् समीकरिष्यामि हत्वा शत्रूम् स्तनानघ
verses.iast:
tasmāttvayā samārabdham karma hyapratimam paraiḥ |
aham samīkariṣyāmi hatvā śatrūm stanānagha
verses.translation: "O, irreproachable brother! Therefore by killing your enemies, I shall neutralize the dishonourable act undertaken by you in relation to your enemies."

verses.devanagari:
अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूंस्तव निशाचर |
यदि शक्रविवस्वन्तौ यदि पावकमारुतौ
तावहम् योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि |
verses.iast:
ahamutsādayiṣyāmi śatrūṃstava niśācara |
yadi śakravivasvantau yadi pāvakamārutau
tāvaham yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāvapi |
verses.translation: "O, ranger of night! I shall destroy your enemies. I shall do battle with the two brothers, even if they are Indra and the sun-god or the god of fire and the wind-god or Kubera (the god of riches) and Varuna (the god of water).

glosses.meaning: even if god of fire and the wind-god
or Kubera (the god of riches) and Varuna (the god of water).

verses.devanagari:
गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य महापरिघयोधिनः
नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदम्ष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाद्वै पुरन्दरः |
verses.iast:
girimātraśarīrasya mahāparighayodhinaḥ
nardatastīkśṇadamṣṭrasya bibhīyādvai purandaraḥ |
verses.translation: "Entering the combat with a mountain-sized body and fiery teeth, roaring the while and attacking with an immense bludgeon, I shall strike terror in Indra himself!"

glosses.meaning: indeed will be afraid of me

verses.devanagari:
पुनर्माम् सद्वितीयेन शरेण निहनिष्यति
ततोऽहम् तस्य पास्यामि रुधिरम् काममाश्वस |
verses.iast:
punarmām sadvitīyena śareṇa nihaniṣyati
tato'ham tasya pāsyāmi rudhiram kāmamāśvasa |
verses.translation: "Even before Rama strikes me once more with a second arrow, I shall drink his blood. Cheer up freely.

verses.devanagari:
वधेव वै दाशरथेह् सुखावहम् |
जयम् तवाहर्तुमहम् तयिष्ये |
हत्वा च रामम् सह लक्ष्मणेन |
खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान्
verses.iast:
vadheva vai dāśaratheh sukhāvaham |
jayam tavāhartumaham tayiṣye |
hatvā ca rāmam saha lakśmaṇena |
khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān
verses.translation: "I shall try to fetch victory, which brings pleasure to you, by the killing of Rama. By exterminating Rama along with Lakshmana, I shall devour all the leaders of monkey-troops."

glosses.meaning: all hariyuuthamukhyaan = the leaders of monkey- troops."

verses.devanagari:
रमस्व कामम् पिब चाग्र्यवारुणीम् |
कुरुष्व कार्वाणि हितानि विज्वरः |
मया तु रामे गमिते यमक्षयम् |
चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति
verses.iast:
ramasva kāmam piba cāgryavāruṇīm |
kuruṣva kārvāṇi hitāni vijvaraḥ |
mayā tu rāme gamite yamakśayam |
cirāya sītā vaśagā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "Enjoy yourself freely. Drink excellent of wines to the extent of your desire without any anxiety. Rama, having been dispatched by me to the abode of death, Seetha will be at your disposal forever."
